in_marathi.name: Jitendra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory of the inner self
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jitendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jitendra is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘jita’ meaning victory and ‘indra’ meaning inner self or mind. This name signifies the victory of the inner self over external challenges. In Hindu mythology, Jitendra is the name of a deity who is believed to bestow inner strength and courage.
